events.name: Bash
events.head: Check branch ancestry, repo state and cloud source layout
events.input: $ git fetch origin 2>&1 | tail -2; git merge-base --is-ancestor e4bd0b8 origin/main && echo ANCESTOR_OK || echo NOT_ANCESTOR; git rev-parse --short HEAD origin/main; git log --oneline -1 origin/main; git status --short | grep -v '^ D app/public/guides' | head -40; git worktree list | head -30; ls cloud/src 2>/dev/null | head -80

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find the audit findings and recent coordination log entries
events.input: $ grep -n -E 'G098|G099|G104|G105|G110|G011|X016' /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/AUDIT.md | cut -c1-400; tail -15 /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md | cut -c1-300; git -C /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord status --short 2>&1 | head -5

events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect the existing T-258 worktree and branch divergence
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/wt-t258 && git status --short | head -30; git log --oneline -3; git rev-parse --short origin/main; git log --oneline origin/main..main | head -20; echo ---; git log --oneline main..origin/main | head; echo; wc -l cloud/src/*.ts cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py | tail -50; ls cloud/scripts | head -80; ls node_modules cloud/node_modules app/node_modules 2>&1 | head -5

events.name: Bash
events.head: Size up the uncommitted T-258 work and what main gained since
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/wt-t258 && git diff --stat | cat; ls -la cloud/src/jobs-s1.ts cloud/src/connectors/s1.ts app/scripts/probe-s1-auto.mjs; wc -l cloud/src/connectors/s1.ts app/scripts/probe-s1-auto.mjs; ls app/scripts | grep -i -E 'probe-(agentic|centre|onboard|guides|jobs|shapes|dns|cards|cov)' ; ls cloud; cat cloud/package.json | head -30; git log --oneline 0330ca0..origin/main | cat; git diff --stat 0330ca0 origin/main | tail -30

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the uncommitted diff except simulator and coverage

events.name: Bash
events.head: See how the local stack starts and which ports are in use
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/wt-t258 && cat cloud/scripts/local-stack.sh | head -60; ls cloud/.dev.vars cloud/.wrangler 2>&1 | head; lsof -iTCP -sTCP:LISTEN -P 2>/dev/null | grep -E ':(87|88|89|30|31)[0-9]{2} ' | awk '{print $1,$2,$9}' | sort -u

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the dev run scripts and list running dev processes
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/wt-t258 && cat cloud/scripts/run-dev.sh; echo ----; sed -n 1,40p cloud/scripts/run-funnel-preview.sh; echo ----; grep -n -E 'PORT|argv|environ' cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py | head -20; ls -la cloud/.wrangler/state cloud/.wrangler/state/* | head -20; ls /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud/.dev.vars 2>&1; ps aux | grep -E 'wrangler|vendor-sim|next dev|next-server' | grep -v grep | awk '{print $2, $11, $12, $13, $14, $15, $16, $17}' | head -20

events.name: Bash
events.head: Identify the leftover dev server and simulator processes
events.input: $ ps -o pid,lstart,command -p 32209,31339,32185 | cut -c1-600; lsof -a -p 31339 -d cwd -Fn 2>/dev/null | tail -1; lsof -a -p 31339 -iTCP -sTCP:LISTEN -P 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $9}'; ps eww -p 31339 | tr ' ' '\n' | grep -E '^SIM_' ; curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' http://127.0.0.1:8890/ ; ls ~/.config/tantra/ | head -40

events.name: Bash
events.head: Typecheck cloud and app, then run the T-258 probe on the simulator
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/wt-t258/cloud && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -15; echo "cloud tsc exit $?"; cd ../app && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -15; echo "app tsc done"; SIM_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8892 node scripts/probe-s1-auto.mjs "http://127.0.0.1:8890/admin/enter?k=t258-local-admin" 2>&1 | tail -80
